senses.gloss: (b. h.; √בח , v. Ges. H. Dict. s. v.; cmp. בה s. v. בהי) prop. to distinguish, examine (cmp. בון, חזי), hence to try, probe (of metals); to find out.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 87a">Pes. 87ᵃ</cite> <he>בְּחוּנֶיךָ</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>חנוניך</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) thy tried servants.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 515:2">Yalk. Hos. 515</cite>; a. e.

<cite ref="Yoma 73b">Yoma 73ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Shevuot 35b:15">Shebu. 35ᵇ</cite> <he>לא ביחנו</he> they did not ask distinctly. Y. B. Kam. IV, 4ᵇ bot. <he>שב״ד מְבַחֲנִין וכ׳</he> for the court (appointing him guardian) inquires after his character.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 8b">Snh. 8ᵇ</cite> a. e. <he>להַבְחִין בין וכ׳</he> in order to be able to distinguish between the ignorant and the willful transgressor.
